title: HB94 (2025 Regular Session): Prohibits persons from carrying firearms into parade zones

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.030 (RSMo): (8) Carries a firearm or any other weapon readily capable of lethal use into: (a) Any church or place where people have assembled for worship; (b) Any election precinct on any election day; (c) Any building owned or occupied by any agency of the federal government, state government, or political subdivision thereof; or (d) Any parade zone during parade hours, as such terms are defined in section 571.570; or
Section 571.107 (RSMo): (18) Any parade zone during parade hours, as such terms are defined in section 571.570.
Section 571.570 (RSMo): 2. No person shall carry a firearm into any parade zone during parade hours other than a peace officer.
Section 571.570 (RSMo): 3. A parade host shall secure the parade zone by ensuring that any person who enters the parade zone during parade hours is required to enter through a checkpoint in which the person passes through a metal detector or is otherwise scanned by security officers to determine whether the person possesses a firearm. Any person who is found to possess a firearm at a checkpoint shall be barred from entry into the parade zone.
